qol.undoUnsafe: Undo refused: HP, shields, or another part of this record cannot be safely reversed; adjudicate manually.

qol.timingHint: Rounds are relative to now (0 = this round). Several rounds expires at the selected turn start. Arbitrary conditions are confirmed manually. Sustaining only records confirmation; it does not spend actions or extend the duration. A turn start/end that has already passed is scheduled for the next round.
qol.undoHint: Only a narrow set of module changes can be undone, and only if the ship and encounter still match the recorded state. Rolls, actions, critical transitions, initiative, chat and revealed information are not reversed. The latest 80 records are GM whispers; deleting a message removes its record.

droneBlock.choose: Choose a deployed drone for this Strike. Close to decline.
droneBlock.confirm: {attacker}'s {attack} would hit {target} for {amount} damage. {drone} grants resistance {resistance} and will be returned for 10 minutes. Confirm Drone Block and choose how to resolve damage.
droneBlock.automatic: Apply through the starship damage system
droneBlock.manual: Record Drone Block; resolve damage manually
droneBlock.manualFallback: Drone Block will be recorded, but automatic damage confirmation is unavailable; the GM must resolve the Strike damage manually.

droneBlock.protocolManual: Drone Shield Protocol requires manual adjudication.
droneBlock.protocolConfirm: {attacker}'s {attack} would hit {target} for {amount} damage. {drone} is equipped with Drone Shield Protocol. Apply resistance {resistance} manually, track this as one of up to two blocks for that drone, and track its shield (the first block destroys it). Resolve retrieval/repair and redeployment restrictions from the upgrade text yourself. This confirmation does not apply the base Drone Block retrieval or 10-minute cooldown.
droneBlock.protocolManualFallback: Drone Shield Protocol requires manual resolution. Apply resistance {resistance}, track up to two blocks and the drone's shield state (the first block destroys it), and resolve retrieval/repair and redeployment restrictions from the upgrade text. No automatic base retrieval or 10-minute cooldown was applied.
droneBlock.protocolManualResult: Protocol block recorded for manual resolution: apply resistance {resistance}, track this as one of up to two blocks for the drone, and track its shield (the first block destroys it). Resolve retrieval/repair and redeployment restrictions from the upgrade text. No base-rule retrieval or 10-minute cooldown was applied.
droneBlock.repeated: Drone Block was already recorded for this Strike.

mineAssist.title: Prepare mine resolution
mineAssist.explain: Creates GM-only native damage and basic Reflex links. Choose reaction only after confirming that a starship entered or left this mine’s zone within sensor range. Resolve each affected ship manually, then mark the mine detonated. Repeating this creates another card. No action or reaction is spent automatically.

mineAssist.chatHint: Mine in zone {zone}: roll damage and basic Reflex saves for affected starships; apply results manually. Then mark the mine detonated.
mineAssist.invalid: Cannot prepare resolution: check the armed mine, current combat and range, deployed Pyrotechnics Drone, original operator and their class DC/level. Modified or unrecognized mines require manual adjudication.
mineAssist.moveHint: GM only. One action, tracked manually. The mine must be within sensor range; choose an adjacent zone. No automatic Undo is provided.
mineAssist.confirmFeature: I confirm the operator has Mobile Exocortex
mineAssist.moveInvalid: Cannot move mine: check its ownership, the deployed drone, active combat, sensor range and adjacent destination.
mineAssist.mapWarning: Mapped ships in the mine’s zone (including hidden contacts): verify the map is complete and correct. Saves and damage remain manual.
mineAssist.exclude: Smart Mine: exclude one mapped ship
mineAssist.excluded: excluded from this blast — GM must enforce
mineAssist.invalidTargets: Cannot prepare: check the mine, operator, combat, range and unambiguous, valid map records. Resolve manually if uncertain.
mineAssist.changed: Mine, combat, ship or map changed while the dialog was open. Review and try again.

mineModify.title: Modify Starship Mine
mineModify.hint: GM-assisted: the operator must be taking their turn, the mine must be in the ship’s zone, and a pyrotechnics drone must be deployed. The modification lasts until the end of the operator’s next turn. Damage and saves remain manual.
mineModify.confirm: I confirm the operator has the mechanic Modify class feature.
mineModify.invalid: Modification refused: check GM confirmation, unique IDs, operator turn and identity, active combat, drone, mine, zone, previous modifications and the request history.
mineModify.smartNote: Smart Mine: GM selects one starship in the zone to exclude from the explosion.
mineModify.targetingNote: Targeting Mine: add {bonus} damage. Roll and apply this manually.
mineModify.manualDamage: Manual damage roll: {formula}, {type}. Do not omit the bonus.
mineModify.card: Modification: {kind}. It lasts until the end of the operator’s next turn; resolution remains manual.
mineModify.cardFailed: The mine modification was saved, but its GM card failed. Check the mine before retrying.
mineModify.changed: The ship or encounter changed during the request; the mine was not modified. Review the current state.

mineGuided.title: Mine resolution: in progress
mineGuided.mapWarning: Mapped targets only: GM must verify every ship in the zone, including those missing from the map.
mineGuided.rolling: Roll in progress or outcome uncertain — inspect before retrying
mineGuided.manualRoll: Damage roll unavailable or uncertain — resolve manually; check before retrying
mineGuided.manualSave: Save unavailable or uncertain — resolve manually; check before retrying
mineGuided.stale: The ship, mine, combat or map changed. Stop and review these partial results; do not apply them automatically.
mineGuided.manual: No HP/SP, conditions or mine state were changed. Check defenses and apply each result manually; inspect chat and state before retrying.
mineGuided.review: Review native results; select a degree for each unresolved save or leave pending. A manual value is an explicit GM decision. No damage is applied.
mineGuided.invalid: Invalid result; review the existing card and resolve manually.
mineGuided.enable: Run guided damage and available native saves after confirmation (GM only)
mineGuided.progressFailed: Could not save the progress card; inspect chat and state before retrying.
mineGuided.activeGM: Only the active GM can run guided rolls. Ask the active GM to open the helper.

harryAssist.title: Harry Sensors — GM aid
harryAssist.intro: Operator {operator}, zone {zone}. Choose one starship in the same zone.
harryAssist.warning: Verify map completeness. The system save is attempted only when available; otherwise enter the result manually. Conditions and expiry require GM.
harryAssist.manualDC: Enter the higher class or spell DC, verified by the GM
harryAssist.invalid: Cannot prepare Harry Sensors: check the console, operator, drone, map and DC.
harryAssist.changed: State changed; inspect the existing partial card and resolve manually.
harryAssist.rolling: Roll in progress or uncertain: inspect before retrying
harryAssist.manual: No reliable native result; resolve this save manually, checking chat first.
harryAssist.notApplied: No conditions were applied. GM must apply the proper SF2e conditions and remove them at the correct time.
harryAssist.success: Success: off-kilter until the start of the target’s next turn.
harryAssist.criticalFailure: Critical failure: off-kilter and off-guard while off-kilter from this effect.
harryAssist.progressFailed: Could not save the progress card; inspect chat and state before retrying.
harryAssist.activeGM: Only the active GM can run guided rolls. Ask the active GM to open the helper.

interceptAssist.title: Record manual Intercept Munitions
interceptAssist.manual: This does not change any attack roll. Before its result is finalized, GM must manually apply the −2 circumstance penalty using the system and verify the Strike would hit. Only then record its use. The drone is unavailable for this reaction until Retrieve Drone.
interceptAssist.strike: Unique reference for this Strike (letters, digits, dot, dash, underscore or colon)
interceptAssist.confirm: I confirmed the trigger and manually applied the penalty before resolving the Strike
interceptAssist.invalid: Cannot record: check the GM confirmation, active combat, unique station and drone, operator, Strike reference, and whether this drone already used Intercept.
interceptAssist.recorded: Drone {drone}: manual Intercept recorded for Strike {strike}.
interceptAssist.used: Intercept used; retrieve this drone before using again
interceptAssist.cardFailed: The drone state was saved, but the card failed. Inspect the drone before retrying.
interceptAssist.preRollHint: Possible Intercept Munitions on {ship}: {drones}. If the Strike would hit, GM adjudicates −2 circumstance; use the drone console’s manual Intercept record. This notice does not change the roll.

mineApply.invalid: The mine result or receipt is invalid. GM review is required.
mineApply.changed: The encounter changed; no further damage was applied.
mineApply.readOnly: This target is a read-only Compendium Actor. Apply its result manually.
mineApply.full: The target’s mine damage receipt storage is full; GM review is required.
mineApply.apply: Apply this result through ship defenses
mineApply.applyWarning: Select only verified targets to apply. The module uses ship defenses and saves a per-target receipt. Check unlisted ships manually.
mineApply.already: Already recorded for this mine; not applied again
mineApply.missingResult: Result missing; apply manually after review
mineApply.applying: Applying — outcome may be uncertain if disconnected
mineApply.uncertain: Not confirmed; inspect target and receipts before retrying
mineApply.failed: Mine result not confirmed: {message}. Inspect the target and card before any retry.
mineApply.closeWarning: All listed results were processed. Confirm every ship and defense, including ships absent from the map, was handled before marking this mine detonated.
mineApply.reminder: Check each target status and any missing ships, and inspect the Actor and card before retrying. The mine remains armed until explicitly closed.

harryApply.confirm: Apply the module ship effect to this target
harryApply.limit: Uses existing module ship effects, not a native SF2e condition. Success requires a unique ship combatant to expire; otherwise apply manually. Check off-guard interactions outside module attacks.
harryApply.invalid: Target, combat or result is unavailable.
harryApply.anchor: The target’s next turn cannot be determined; apply and remove manually.
harryApply.applied: Module effect applied. GM must check system conditions and clear indefinite effects when appropriate.
harryApply.manual: Application was not confirmed; inspect the target and apply manually.
harryApply.failed: Harry effect not confirmed: {message}. Inspect the target before retrying.

petCabin.title: Onboard Pet
petCabin.active: Active: quickened for Drone Console station actions only; apply the system condition manually. World time ends at
petCabin.expired: Ended or unverifiable; GM must clear cockpit and any manually applied condition
petCabin.check: Choose a living Tiny world Actor. Verify that it is an eligible companion of the operator and adjacent to this console. The system quickened condition is not applied automatically.
petCabin.confirm: GM confirms eligibility, relationship and proximity
petCabin.none: No living Tiny world Actor was found.
petCabin.invalid: Pet, console, upgrade, time or cockpit state is invalid; inspect the cockpit.
petCabin.endConfirm: End the cabin effect and free the cockpit? Remove any manually applied quickened condition only if appropriate.
petCabin.started: Pet onboard recorded. GM applies quickened manually for Drone Console station actions only, checks duration and ends it as appropriate.
petCabin.ended: Pet cabin effect ended; GM checks any manually applied condition.
petCabin.cardFailed: The cabin was saved but its chat card failed. Inspect state before retrying.
petCabin.autoEnded: Pet cabin effect on {ship} ended. The GM must review and manually remove any applied condition, then clear the cabin.
petCabin.monitorFailed: Could not save the end of the pet cabin effect; the GM must review and end it manually now.

mineReaction.hint: Possible mine reaction: mine {mine} from {ship}. The GM or operator decides whether to detonate; use the drone console helper. No detonation occurred.
mineReaction.more: More than 10 possible mine reactions; inspect the map and consoles.

protocolAssist.title: Drone Shield Protocol
protocolAssist.confirm: GM confirms the trigger and manual resolution
protocolAssist.blockHint: First manually apply resistance {resistance} to damage from the triggering Strike only. This button records use; it does not apply resistance. Check that the Strike hit.
protocolAssist.fetchHint: Confirm Fetch and Fix immediately after the recorded Drone Block. The drone returns, is repaired and cannot deploy for two rounds in this combat.
protocolAssist.invalid: Protocol, drone, operator, combat or reference is invalid; inspect the ship and chat.
protocolAssist.blockRecorded: Drone {drone}: manual Drone Block recorded. The GM applied the Strike-specific resistance.
protocolAssist.fetchRecorded: Drone {drone}: Fetch and Fix recorded; drone returned with a two-round deployment restriction.
protocolAssist.cardFailed: The drone state was saved but its card failed; inspect before retrying.

privateMap.activeGM: Only the active GM can manage private contacts. No secret is sent over the module socket.
privateMap.invalidStore: Private sensor store is missing, duplicated, invalid or has unsafe permissions. Check its ownership and folder.
privateMap.invalidActor: A private contact must be a world NPC starship or hazard with verifiable permissions.
privateMap.actorExposed: This Actor is accessible to a player or already a combatant. Its identity may already be disclosed; private placement is refused.
privateMap.alreadyPublic: This ship is already on the shared map; it cannot be made secret retroactively.
privateMap.hint: A staged contact is unavailable to targeting and hazard automation. Hidden contacts are withheld; observed contacts disclose only an anonymous position. Verify world permissions independently.
privateMap.revealWarning: Publish this contact’s identity and position to every client? Information already delivered cannot be retracted.
privateMap.observedWarning: Publish an anonymous contact and its position to all clients? This information cannot be retracted from clients that received it.
privateMap.legacyNotesWarning: Zone notes are shared in Combat flags, including old GM notes. Do not enter secrets; existing notes are retained but cannot be edited here.
privateMap.disclosureRequired: Public hazard placement requires explicit publicActor=true and detection=identified; other placements may expose secrets.

installMine.title: Install Mine — GM preparation
installMine.hint: Operator: {operator}. Enter up to four separately identified mines and their actual personal Mine Exocortex mods. No onboard inventory exists in this module; these are GM notes, not automated mine effects. Review rules and duration manually.
installMine.confirm: I verified Mine Exocortex, the mines, the known mods, their applicability and duration; replacing a previous plan is intentional.
installMine.invalid: Install Mine preparation is invalid or the console, operator, shell or undeployed drone changed.
installMine.card: Preparation only: no modification is applied automatically or transferred on deploy. Check duration and apply the actual personal mod manually.
installMine.cardFailed: Preparation was saved, but the GM card could not be created.

mineStock.installHint: {operator} modifies up to four starship mines inside the undeployed pyrotechnics drone. Choose a stored mine or create a new one for each row, then pick a confirmed modification.
mineStock.label: Mine name
mineStock.confirm: I confirm the operator uses the Mine Exocortex and that this modification is allowed by the Tech Core rules. It stays with the mine and has no automatic effect.
mineStock.classOverride: The operator is not a mechanic. Install anyway (GM override).
mineStock.classUnknown: The operator's class could not be determined; the GM confirms it.
mineStock.knownHint: Record a Mine Exocortex modification that {operator} knows. It is an opaque confirmed note; it is not Smart Mine or Targeting Mine.
mineStock.knownConfirm: I confirm the operator knows this modification.
mineStock.plainNote: Only prepared mines are counted; plain mines are not limited by the recorded rules.
mineStock.discardConfirm: Remove this stored mine and its modification from the drone?
mineStock.card: The mines are now stored in the drone with their confirmed modifications. Deploy Starship Mine places a chosen mine on the Sensor Map.
mineStock.cardFailed: Install Mine was saved, but the GM note could not be posted.
mineStock.chooseHint: A stored mine keeps its confirmed modifications. Choose a mine that is stored in the selected drone.

errors.invalid: Install Mine is not available: check the console, the operator, the Mine Deployment Shell and that the pyrotechnics drone is not deployed.
errors.class: The operator is not a mechanic.
errors.mod: Choose a known modification of this operator.
errors.stock: That stored mine is not in the selected drone.
errors.modified: That mine already has an installed modification.
errors.receipts: Too many recorded Install Mine operations for this drone.
errors.legacy: The drone or console data is damaged; nothing was changed.

mineContact.name: Starship mine: {label}
mineContact.description: A starship mine deployed by {ship}. The mine is tracked on the ship's drone; this Hazard sheet only shows its information.
mineContact.rule: Detonation: 2d8 fire or piercing damage with a basic Reflex save against the operator's class DC (scaled by the module's mine helper). The GM resolves it with the mine helper.
mineContact.manual: These notes are confirmed by the GM and do not create automatic effects.
mineContact.invalid: The mine or its ship was not found.
mineContact.duplicate: Several documents describe the same mine. Remove the extra ones and synchronize again.
mineContact.managed: This contact follows the mine record on the ship. Move, detonate or remove the mine from the ship sheet.
mineContact.managedHint: This contact is managed by the mine record: its position and removal follow the drone.
mineContact.syncFailed: The mine is saved, but its Sensor Map contact was not updated: {message}
mineContact.syncHint: Recreate or update the mine's Hazard Actor and Sensor Map contact

sync.added: Mine contact added to the Sensor Map.
sync.removed: Mine contact removed from the map.
sync.unchanged: The mine contact is up to date.
sync.skipped: The mine belongs to another combat.

contactEditor.title: Add Sensor Map object
contactEditor.intro: Place a hazard, Starship Actor, or custom contact. Players see nothing until you choose a state that discloses it.
contactEditor.noChoices: No hazards or Starship Actors found.
contactEditor.copyNote: A separate world Actor is created for each placement, leaving the compendium source unchanged.
contactEditor.detectionHint: Undetected and hidden stay private. Observed shows an anonymous marker; identified discloses the Actor identity and requires confirmation.
contactEditor.confirm: I confirm that players may learn this information.
